newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse up, div boosts Standard Chartered.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse up, div boosts Standard Chartered.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange edged higher on Monday but volume was again low and an increase in one share, Standard Chartered, was mainly responsible for the rise.
The GSE All-Share index rose 5.22 points to 413.62.
Standard Chartered was in demand after the recent announcement of a 500 cedi interim dividend, payable on August 29. The shares added 500 to 5,800 cedis.
Ashanti Goldfields fell 100 to 21,600 but most other stocks were unchanged.
Volume was an extremely low 38,740 shares. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
